chapter_title: Learning Experience Design and Software Technology
title: Feedback Loops and Learner Control
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting feedback loops and learner control to a feedback-loop specification (feed-forward text, reveal-timing rule, calibrated control, behavioral signal), reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the feedback-loop specification (feed-forward text, reveal-timing rule, calibrated control with named skip cost) shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
